findings.affected: All 29 high-confidence picks
findings.summary: The brief's two high-confidence rules are mutually exclusive as literally worded: ">70% chance to win" and "priced between -250 and +10000".
findings.evidence: At our documented 5% overround a 68.0% model probability prices at exactly -250 (1/(0.68*1.05) = 1.400). Any selection above 68.0% is therefore automatically shorter than -250, so a 70%+ pick can never satisfy the window. There is no arithmetic overlap between the two rules. No governing body publishes a source for our own margin policy, so this row links the methodology page instead of dressing up an unrelated league page as proof.
findings.resolution: The window is treated as the binding constraint because it is the explicit numeric instruction. High confidence now requires verified status, two measured official ratings, the sport's separation threshold, AND a published price inside -250..+10000 at 60%+ model probability. The probability-only rule survives as the separation filter; the >70% reading is retired and documented on Methodology.
